title: Generator value of the right tensor-evaluation restriction composite
statement: Let C be a category essentially small in the coefficient universe max(c,v,r), J a Grothendieck topology, B,tau and D,sigma inverse sequences of commutative ring sheaves, alpha_n : B_n to D_n level maps, phi a morphism of their ring systems, M a B-system, and n a natural number [def-coef-semilinear-system-models]. Suppose e_U is a D_n(U)-linear isomorphism from the finite-level tensor module to the vertically evaluated system tensor module, with the evaluation_ring coefficient transport, and e_U sends every pure tensor a tensor x to the corresponding raw-system tensor. For a morphism f : U to V in C^op and a section x at U, e_U followed by system tensor restriction sends 1 tensor x to 1 tensor the raw restriction of x.

source.place: Section 03EK (section-tensor-product) and Tag 03CY (lemma-sheafification-presheaf-modules), applied to vertical restriction in blueprint classes (2)

proof.text: Use tensorRestriction_tmul for the system tensor presheaf, which sends 1 tensor x to 1 tensor the restricted x, since ring maps preserve one. Apply the pure-tensor equation of e at U. The raw and evaluated module restriction maps have the same underlying function.

theorem scalarExtension_evaluation_restriction_right
    {U V : Cᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V)
    (x : ((evaluation.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ n).obj M).val.obj U) :
    (SheafOfModules.changeOfRingsPresheaf.{v, c, max c v r} φ M).map
      ((Prod.sectR n C).map f.unop).op
        ((e U).hom
          ((1 : (D n).obj.obj U) ⊗ₜ[(B n).obj.obj U,((α n).hom.app U).hom] x)) =
    (1 : (systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J D σ).obj.obj (op (n, V.unop)))
      ⊗ₜ[(systemRing.{c, v, max c v r} J B τ).obj.obj (op (n, V.unop)),
        (φ.hom.app (op (n, V.unop))).hom]
        (show M.val.obj (op (n, V.unop)) from
          M.val.map ((Prod.sectR n C).map f.unop).op x)
